apps.title: Ludo Go! - Dice Board Games
apps.summary:
Discover Ludo Go!, a fun board game where every dice roll brings you closer to victory! Move the pieces across the board, knock opponents back to start, and race to bring all your pieces to the finish first. The gameplay feels simple, competitive, and rewarding, blending classic ludo rules with familiar parchis-style routes, parchisi traditions, and smart tactical choices.

Looking for a fun board game that is easy to start but keeps every move interesting? This dice game gives you simple rules from the first roll while adding more depth as you progress.If you enjoy board games like ludo and parcheesi, you’ll appreciate how every level brings a new board layout, fresh challenges, and new ways to outplay your opponent. Roll the dice, choose your best move, use special tiles, and turn every race into a fun game clash!

How to play Ludo Go!:

• Roll the dice and move your pieces across the board.
• Roll a 6 to leave the starting area and enter the race.
• Land on an opponent’s tile to knock their piece back to start.
• Choose which piece to move and plan your route to the finish.
• Use bonus tiles to move forward, move back, teleport, or trigger special effects.
• Unlock unique piece abilities and make your moves even stronger.
• Bring all your pieces to the finish before your opponent to win the level.

If you’re exploring board games for free, or two player games, Ludo Go! adds a fresh level-based twist to classic dice game fun!

✔ Fast dice rolls, smart moves, and satisfying moments when you knock opponents back.

✔ Colorful board locations, from desert and tropical areas to snowy lands and more.
✔ New level layouts, bonus mechanics, and special tiles that appear as you progress.
✔ Easy to play, but full of tactical decisions that make every dice roll feel important.

14 difficulty tiers offer a tailored experience for everyone, from casual explorers to hardcore strategists.

apps.title: Loop Master: Color Jam Sort
apps.summary:
Loop Master: Color Jam Sort is a relaxing puzzle with a fresh conveyor twist, blending colorful sorting, smart crate filling, and smooth loop-based logic into a calm but satisfying experience.

🎮 In Loop Master: Color Jam Sort, you sort colorful cubes and cards into matching crates in a relaxing conveyor loop puzzle with no timers and no rush. Just pure color sort gameplay that clears your mind while you clear the board. If you love sorting games with unique conveyor mechanics and cozy puzzle vibes, this is your perfect match.

🌀 Sorting in Motion

This is more than a simple color sort. The loop keeps everything moving, so timing, order, and space management matter just as much as matching the right colors.

🏆 One Conveyor Loop, One Goal

In Loop Master: Color Jam Sort, every move is about keeping the conveyor flowing, matching colors efficiently, and making smart use of limited space.

• Tap to send cubes onto the conveyor and set the loop in motion.
• As cubes travel around the belt, they wait for the right crate to open up.
• Gather four cubes of the same color in one crate to combine them into a complete piece.

Keep the Loop Clear

• Watch the conveyor capacity carefully, because only a limited number of cube groups can stay on the loop at once.
• If the conveyor fills up and no useful moves remain, the round comes to an end.
• Every open slot can change your next move, so keeping space available is part of the puzzle itself.
• In some levels, only the top color is visible at first, while the cubes below stay hidden until they are revealed one by one.
• This hidden-color twist makes every early move more important, because one choice can affect which colors appear next.

Plan your moves, control the flow, and enjoy the satisfaction of every perfect merge.

⚡ Tools to Keep the Loop Moving

When the conveyor gets crowded, the right tool can help you fix mistakes, reopen space, and keep your sorting plan alive.

• Undo – Take the card on the conveyor back to the box and undo your last move. It’s perfect for correcting a rushed decision before it causes bigger problems.

• Shuffle – Select a plank and shuffle the color cubes inside. Use it to reset a tricky arrangement and open up new matching possibilities.

• Extra – Add 2 more capacity slots when you need more room. It gives you valuable breathing space when the loop gets tight and every open spot matters.

🎁 More Levels, More Rewards

Every completed level gives you something to look forward to. Win more levels to earn rewards, collect level gifts, and unlock limited-time perks like 30-minute unlimited lives that let you keep playing with fewer interruptions.

👍 Why You’ll Love It

• A fresh conveyor loop twist that makes every sort feel more dynamic.
• Clean, low-randomness puzzle play where smart planning pays off.
• Great for a quick break, with enough depth to keep longer sessions rewarding.
• Offline-friendly gameplay that fits wherever you want to play.
• A great match for fans of color sorting, card puzzles, and calm brain games.

Ready to clear the loop and master the flow? Start Loop Master: Color Jam Sort now and enjoy a fresh sorting puzzle built around calm strategy and satisfying progress.

Clear the Loop. Match the Card. Sort the Cube.

🚚 Highway Heroes is the truck tycoon management game where strategy beats speed. Build a freight company from the ground up, plan smart routes across U.S. regions, and grow your idle tycoon empire through careful decisions — not quick reflexes. If you love a logistics game that rewards patience and planning, welcome home.

Every dollar earned is a decision made — reinvest in your fleet, expand your facilities, or unlock new regions. With idle tycoon earnings working for you around the clock, your company never stops growing.

Every upgrade in this management game reshapes how your business operates — faster maintenance, smarter logistics, and bigger contracts within reach.

Managing contracts in this truck tycoon feels like running a real business: orderly, fair, and deeply satisfying.

🛻 Collect iconic American haulers in this management game. From classic rigs to modern workhorses, each truck unlocks new routes and contract types. This is a logistics game where your collection has real strategic value — not just cosmetic appeal. Every truck you add strengthens your fleet with new cargo options and better efficiency across regions.

👀 See everything at a glance. Crisp isometric angles, clear icons, and legible text make complex decisions feel simple. - Treasure hunting: Do your job to earn HypnoCoins, or ignore your inbox and go hunting for hidden pages, downloads and secrets!

- Relive your childhood: Equip obnoxious screensavers and skins for your desktop, and wiggle your mouse pointer around to make pages load faster!

Optimized for mobile with full touch controls and revamped UI!

apps.title: Sort Art - Pixel Coloring Game
apps.summary:
Sort Art is a captivating puzzle game that blends pixel coloring and tile sorting in one relaxing, satisfying experience. Rearrange colorful tiles, match them with the correct pegs, and gradually reveal beautiful pixel art. Watch the picture come to life with every move, turning a jumbled-up board into a stunning masterpiece!

Sort Art goes beyond the classic coloring games—you don't just tap to fill spaces. In Sort Art, you think ahead, organize your moves strategically, and sort groups of colored tiles into the right places. This is one of the sorting games with no timer, no pressure, and no way to fail—just a calming experience in a color game.

How to play:
• Tap a tile to select its connected group of the same color.
• Move the selected tiles onto matching free pegs.
• Use the tray to temporarily store tiles and plan your next moves.
• Complete every color, and reveal the full pixel picture.
• Finish the level of this sort puzzle by placing every tile on its matching peg.

As you play, you'll unlock extra tray space to make larger pixel puzzles even more enjoyable. Each completed color expands your storage, giving you new ways to organize tiles and create increasingly intricate pixel art. Like other free coloring games, every level has fresh images to discover, from cute animals and colorful berries to cozy scenes and more!

Why you'll love Sort Art:
• A unique blend of sorting games and coloring
• Relaxing gameplay with no timers or stressful challenges
• Easy controls that anyone can pick up
• A coloring game with satisfying tile movements and smooth animations
• Beautiful pixel pictures, revealed piece by piece
• Clever color sort puzzles that encourage strategic thinking without feeling overwhelming
• Hundreds of handcrafted levels
• Perfect for short breaks or long, cozy play sessions

Whether you're a fan of sorting games, jewel and diamond painting, or relaxing coloring games for adults, Sort Art offers a fresh twist that keeps every level engaging. Slow down, sort the colors, and experience the simple satisfaction of putting every tile exactly where it belongs. Download Sort Art, and unwind with this calm coloring game!

Pull yourself up from the gutter and take control of the underground in Narco Empire. Step into a raw, cinematic underbelly of secret labs, risky shipments, and bloody turf clashes — every choice about trust, risk, and ambition pushes you from a nobody on the block to a leader people fear.

From corner deals to the throne
Begin with small trades and tough calls. Make allies, collect favors, and turn tiny wins into real standing. As your influence grows, neighborhoods fall under your control, and each decision opens new chances — and new dangers.

Run the underground supply
Hunt down scarce materials across contested blocks and hide workshops that slowly turn into full operations. Close-up, hands-on lab scenes let you sharpen your product and raise its value on the black market. Improve how you work, bring in trusted hands, and scale from cramped benches to full factories.

Plot dangerous smuggling runs
Plan routes, prepare convoys, and react fast when things break down. Send guarded loads through hostile zones, pick stealth or force, bribe contacts, or sabotage rival narco crews — and always watch for checkpoints. Each successful run opens new trade corridors and extends your reach.

Turn goods into clout
Use distribution to build power: run street deals, land big wholesale contracts, and launder dirty cash into a respectable front. Oversee retail chains, pressure or partner with rivals, and plant investments that keep your empire hidden from view.

Keep the crown — and survive
Power draws betrayal. One mistake can wipe everything out. Recruit loyal lieutenants, sharpen your enforcers, and flush out moles before they strike. Diplomacy, threats, and targeted strikes are all in your playbook — but loyalties can flip overnight. Will you rule from the shadows, or become just another name in a police file?

Disclaimer: This game is a work of fiction. All substances, events, and characters portrayed are fictional. Please play responsibly.

apps.title: Mystery Detective Adventure 2
apps.summary:
Having gained a reputation as a man versed in the occult, Detective Woodbrey has attracted a rather peculiar clientele. Whether that is good or bad is for you to decide!

“Mystery Detective Adventure 2” is an adventure game in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.

The world does not stand still—and neither does the world of crime. Thieves and murderers are becoming ever more cunning and twisted. And while others argue over who should make the streets safe and life fair, Detective John Woodbrey takes action, no matter what.
His experience played a cruel joke on him: he failed his last case after becoming too absorbed in paranormal phenomena and losing touch with reality. But his respite will not last forever—retirement is still a long way off.
With a reputation as a detective versed in the occult, he finds mystic cases drawn to him. He will have to undertake three investigations—three unique and dangerous adventures. Their unpredictable nature will force you to find solutions on the fly and quickly adapt to the situation. There will be no time to be bored!

- Close extraordinary cases that only you can handle.
- Each investigation tells its own story, with unique locations and characters.
- Complete collections by studying the world carefully and missing none of even the smallest details.
- Examine locations carefully and find every collectible
- Join the battle for freedom alongside your favorite characters

apps.summary:
The first official hololive mobile game『hololive Dreams (holodori)』 is here, featuring a rhythm & RPG gameplay!
Centered around rhythm games, the game includes a variety of content such as theme park development and mini-games!
Over 50 hololive members make an appearance, and the initial tracklist will include 150+ songs!
A game that both hololive fans and newcomers can enjoy. The way you play is entirely up to you!

▼A full-fledged rhythm game▼
Enjoy a genuine rhythm game based on official music videos and live concert videos!

The game features an ""Original Chart"" function, allowing you to make and share your own original charts!
・Extremely challenging, hardcore charts for dedicated players!
・Charts filled with love for the talents!
・Fun and quirky charts that everyone can enjoy together!
And more! You are the limit!
Play with charts created by players from all around the world, and experience endless fun!

Even if you're not good at rhythm games, you can enjoy it worry-free with the auto-play feature!
Aim for higher scores by training and organizing your talents!

▼A wide variety of over 150 songs at launch!▼
From hololive songs to cover songs!
The lineup includes everything from the latest hits to classic tracks!

hololive songs
・BIBBIDIBA
・Shiny Smily Story
・BLUE CLAPPER
And more!

Cover songs
・The Brave
・Megitsune
・Watashi no Ichiban Kawaiitokoro
And more!

▼The game is set in a theme park▼
hololive members have arrived to an uninhabited island floating somewhere in the world.
And you will need to team up with them to develop your very own dream theme park!

Play rhythm games and mini-games to complete quests and expand your theme park!
Also, by completing holomem Quests, you can unlock and add more playable talents!
Unlock your favorite holomem and build your dream theme park!
Many facilities full of hololive’s unique charm will also take the stage!
Experience an original story unique to this game!

Aim to complete your dream theme park!

▼Mini-games. Solo or with everyone!▼
The game will include a variety of mini-games that can be enjoyed alone or with friends!
Have fun with everyone or compete against others!

Includes mini-games with simple controls, so even those who struggle with tricky actions can enjoy them!
A wide lineup ranging from casual games you can play in a short time, to challenging, hardcore games you'll want to keep replaying!

Earn rewards by playing, and use them to speed up the talent’s growth and theme park development!

apps.title: The Walking Dead: Aftermath
apps.summary:
The dead walk. Society has fallen. Survival is all that remains.

Rick Grimes woke from a coma to find the world transformed. Cities abandoned. Families torn apart. The living forced to become something new just to survive. Step into the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead universe and begin your journey where it all started, in an action game shaped by the characters and stories fans know and love.

Now it’s your turn.

Begin your journey on the outskirts of Atlanta, where a fragile camp struggles to endure against the constant threat of the walkers. What starts as a desperate fight for survival quickly becomes something more. A test of leadership and who you are willing to become.

You are not alone.

Fight as iconic survivors from across the universe of AMC’s The Walking Dead, including Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon, Michonne, Glenn, and Maggie. Each survivor brings unique weapons, abilities, and combat styles into every run. Whether you prefer precision, power, or survival instincts, your choice of fighter will shape every encounter.

Every Survivor has their strengths.

🏕️ Build your camp and assign garrison survivors to strengthen defenses, generate resources, and support your long-term survival
⚔️ Take control of combat survivors with distinct abilities and playstyles in every run

Every decision matters. Every run is different.

🔥 Fight through relentless swarms and herds of walkers, including armored, burning, and other deadly walker variants
⚠️ Face dangerous human enemies, desperate to survive by any means necessary
📈 Grow stronger every run with new abilities, upgrades, and evolving strategies
🏕️ Build and defend your camp, turning a fragile shelter into a place worth fighting for
⚔️ Choose your approach, whether aggressive, tactical, or survival-focused
🌍 Explore locations inspired by the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead

Survival is not just about fighting the dead. It is about protecting the living.

Fans of survival games, roguelite progression, and action RPG gameplay will find a fast-paced experience built around skill, growth, and replayability.

The world has ended. The fight has just begun.

How long can you survive?

This is just the beginning.
Join our Discord for updates, events, and to share your feedback as we continue to expand the world of The Walking Dead.

apps.title: Toca Boca Jr Kitchen NETFLIX
apps.summary:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED. AD-FREE, UNLIMITED ACCESS FOR NETFLIX MEMBERS.

Create weird and wonderful recipes for guests in this open-ended cooking game for kids. Spaghetti smoothie? Deep-fried watermelon? Go ahead, try it!

"Toca Boca Jr Kitchen" invites all young chefs to get messy and start playing. With three guests to cook for, a kitchen full of different tools to use and countless food combinations to test out, the possibilities are infinite.

GET CREATIVE IN THE KITCHEN
Who said meals have to look good — or taste good? In "Toca Boca Jr Kitchen," you can cook however you want! Boil a salad, juice a shrimp or fry up a pineapple. Come up with your very own recipes and treat your guests to something special.

GO AHEAD, MAKE A MESS
With five different kitchen tools to choose from, you can explore all kinds of food experiments. Will you chop and sauté, or just load everything into the juicer? Prep your favorite ingredients, get messy and finish off with a pinch of something unexpected.

WATCH THEIR REACTIONS
Time to let your guest have a bite! Is it a winner? Discover your guests' preferences by seeing how they react. Oven-baked fish head with fried leftovers and lettuce juice coming right up! Oh, they didn't like it? Try adding some salt. It's fun to get the "ew"!

FEATURES:
• Three characters to feed, each with their own likes and dislikes
• A fridge full of fun ingredients, from oranges to octopus
• Five kitchen tools to cook with, including a juicer and oven
• No rules or stress — just open-ended, kid-directed fun
• No third-party advertising

ABOUT TOCA BOCA
We believe in the power of play to spark kids' imaginations and help them learn about the world. We design our products from the kids' perspective to empower kids to be playful, to be creative and to be who they want to be. Our products include award-winning apps that have been downloaded more than 200 million times in 215 countries and offer fun, open-ended play experiences.

- Created by Toca Boca.

Simple to learn, hard to put down. Whether you're clearing rows of colorful blocks or bringing down giant constructions piece by piece, Knock Out! delivers quick, rewarding gameplay that keeps you coming back for more.

Calculate the perfect strike, and shoot the ball from cannon to knock down tricky block formations! Experience the ultimate fest of destruction as you hit the weak spot, knock out heavy targets, and watch every can and structure smash in a glorious 3D crush.

🧩 Tactical gameplay: Find the hidden weak spots. Outsmart clever setups and knock down every obstacle.

🎪 Endless entertainment: Join the fest and conquer hundreds of unique stages in a vibrant arena designed for relaxation.

🏅 Rewarding progression: Perfect your precision and make expert use of a limited number of balls for that flawless, one-shot clear.

🍃 Instant stress relief: Melt your daily worries away with satisfying, crash-heavy action.

apps.title: Royal Arrow: Merge & Match
apps.summary:
This casual puzzle game focuses on arrow-matching and merging mechanics. Designed with straightforward rules, it offers a relaxing gameplay experience through simple touch controls.
How to Play
Each level features a board filled with arrows pointing in various directions. By tapping and swiping the screen, you direct the paths of these arrows to match and eliminate them. Planning your moves carefully allows you to bypass obstacles, trigger chain reactions, and efficiently clear the board to advance to the next stage.

Game Features

Strategic Level Design: As you progress, the puzzle layouts become increasingly challenging. Different arrow combinations and board mechanics will require spatial thinking and observation to solve.
Offline Play: The game does not require an internet connection. You can play entirely offline, allowing you to enjoy a puzzle session wherever you are.
Casual Experience: With clean visual designs and a laid-back pace, the game is accessible to players of all ages looking for a straightforward puzzle experience during their spare time.
Royal Arrow: Merge & Match is an original puzzle game and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any other brand or company.

apps.summary:
CORE GAMEPLAY

- Destroy Descending Blocks: Blocks descend row by row. Use quick reflexes and precise aiming to clear your path.
- Collect Weapon Supplies: Grab supply drops during the run to activate powerful weapon mods. Spread shots with the Triple Gun, fire in an 8-way pattern, melt barriers with the Laser, or release a swarm of Bouncing Balls!
- Master the ColorWheel: Spin the wheel to switch ammunition types and change your firepower on the fly. Shoot rapid-fire with Blue, deal massive damage with Red, dissolve entire rows with Green Acid, or trigger critical hits with Black.
- Strategic Skill Upgrades: Choose and upgrade your skills. Every build decision directly shapes your survival strategy.

- Dynamic Skill System: Choose and upgrade unique skills to customize your playstyle:
* Turbo Attack: Boosts your firing speed to shred blocks rapidly.
* Split Fire: Fires projectiles sideways to clear wider rows.
* Hydra Vitality: Regenerates your health over time for extra survivability.
* Homing Missile: Launches seeking rockets that track down obstacles.
* Phantom Dodge: Phases your ship to temporarily evade all incoming damage.
* Stopper: Freezes time, completely stopping all descending blocks.
* Summon: Spawns a phantom guardian to mirror and double your firepower.
* Thunder Strike: Unleashes chaining lightning bolts to damage multiple adjacent blocks.
* Anti-Aircraft Helper: Deploys a ground-based helper to blast blocks from below.
- Smooth Mobile Controls: Experience highly responsive touch controls optimized for mobile devices.
- Satisfying Visuals: Enjoy clean graphics and rewarding particle effects every time you smash blocks.
- Pure Arcade Challenge: Easy to learn, challenging to master. Perfect for quick sessions or high-score runs.

PERFECT FOR

- Fans of classic block-breaking games and arcade shooters.
- Players who enjoy making strategic upgrade choices and creating unique builds.
- Anyone looking for a fast-paced, satisfying, and responsive action game.

Test your reflexes, upgrade your skills, and see how long you can survive the falling blocks!

Shadowborn is an arcade-style RPG designed for fast, gripping mobile gameplay. Dive into a rich world of whimsy and darkness letting you carve your path to victory, whether it's a quick battle or a longer, more immersive quest.

The game rewards your skill, allowing you to dodge attacks and time your take-downs to win against the odds.

Your journey doesn't end at victory:

• Power up with new gear, refined strategies, and complete achievements

• 3-4 minute loops offer bite-sized, high-energy action perfect for mobile.
• Each mission drops you instantly into the heart of the action, keeping every session short and intense.

apps.title: Word Solitaire Go
apps.summary:
Word Solitaire Go is a refined word puzzle that blends the familiar structure of classic solitaire with the challenge of organizing meaning. Instead of numbers and suits, you work with complete word cards and group cards, turning a scattered table into a clear solution through thoughtful play.

How to Play
Every level begins with a partially revealed layout. You first establish the foundation by placing group cards, then draw new word cards into play and commit them to the right sets. Each placement shapes the board, opening some possibilities while quietly limiting others.
With a limited number of moves available, timing matters as much as correctness.

Strategy Over Speed
The challenge in Word Solitaire Go doesn’t come from fast reactions or memorization. It comes from judgment. Should you place a word now, or wait for more information? Should you draw another card, or stabilize what’s already on the table?
One decision can determine how the rest of the round unfolds.

Key Features
Solitaire-inspired gameplay using word and group cards
Meaning-based sorting that rewards logic and insight
A move-limited structure where every placement matters
Gradually evolving difficulty without sudden spikes
Clean, focused presentation designed for calm play

Designed for Thoughtful Players
Each session feels complete on its own, offering a clear beginning, rising tension, and a satisfying resolution. Over time, patterns become clearer, decisions sharper, and progress more rewarding.

Word Solitaire Go is calm on the surface, but deeply engaging once you lean in. It’s a game for players who enjoy focus, structure, and the quiet satisfaction of making everything fit.

The world is shrouded in crime. Cities teem with gangs, drug cartels, and assassin syndicates — citizens live in fear. As the newly appointed police chief, you must start small and strategically expand a local precinct while safeguarding the city. Grow your reputation step by step: expand office space, establish new departments, streamline paperwork, recruit elite officers, and equip your team with top-tier gear to tackle increasingly complex cases. Transform a modest station into a prestigious law enforcement headquarters!

1. Design & Build Your Police HQ
Build an empire of justice from the ground up! Freely arrange facilities such as interrogation rooms, holding cells, and armories to optimize investigations. Every brick you lay brings the city closer to order.

2. Recruit Officers & Upgrade Gear
Assemble a dream team of elite officers to dismantle criminal schemes. Invest resources in advanced weaponry and vehicles to handle escalating threats.

Poor meals, cramped cells, or lax surveillance can spark violent uprisings. Mobilize rapid-response teams in riot gear to suppress them before they tank your reputation and funding!

Strategic Depth: Balance budget, reputation, and security in a dynamic crime ecosystem.
Progression System: Evolve from a rundown precinct to a high-tech law enforcement center.
Realistic Challenges: Adapt to gang wars, hostage crises, and corruption scandals.
Can you bring the streets back from the brink? The city’s fate rests in your hands.

apps.title: Sword x Staff
apps.summary:
Sword x Staff is a one-of-a-kind RPG — a “Third Way RPG.”
Strategy, massive world exploration, idle—why pick one when you can have it all?
Go hardcore, or just vibe—either way, you’ll find your own kind of fun here. The kind that actually feels different.
No pressure, no one way to play—just jump in, explore, and let the adventure click your way.
Curious what the gameplay is really like?
So, welcome to the unique world of Kanstein, and experience the one-of-a-kind Third Way adventure. Here, you are the Chosen Adventurer transported to this isekai! Team up with the Staff and Sword Twins and dive into a quest to save the world. Pierce through thick fog, dig up forgotten treasures, and explore a huge interactive world at your own pace. Mix and match over 200 skills to create a fighting style that’s uniquely yours. Best of all, you’ll meet amazing allies to fight by your side against legendary Hieromons! Of course—Remember, all of this can be enjoyed completely pressure-free, since the idle gameplay making resource gathering a breeze！
[Idle Game, but with a massive interactive world]
Most idle games have you waiting. Sword x Staff lets you actually go somewhere.
Step into a huge world map where every region has its own vibe and secrets to uncover. Roam the lush wilds of Verdantglade, face the clash of steel and instinct in Cinder Ridge, drift through the mist-shrouded waters of Aqualis, and uncover the ancient bronze ruins hidden within Loong Haven.
Every region brings new sights, companions, treasures, and those "just one more look" moments. And even when you're offline, your adventure doesn't stop. Resources keep piling up while you rest, and the Traveling Merchant shows up with rare goods while you're away. Log back in, cash out, and keep going.
[Deep strategy, but easy to jump in]
Strategy is fun because of freedom, not because it needs a spreadsheet.
Everything starts with the classic Warrior & Mage dual-class system, branching into 200+ skill combinations and playstyles. Mix skills, change cast order, swap elemental builds, and fine-tune your setup however you like.
No fixed meta. No single "right" answer. Just true variety and real flexibility, and plenty of room to experiment.
Keep it casual, or go full theorycraft mode. How deep you go is completely up to you.
[Progress Without the Grind]
Power up without the endless farming. Even while you're offline, resources stack up, characters grow stronger, and progression keeps moving.
Lie back, rest up, and wake up stronger! Watch clouds drift across the Floating Islands, stargaze from your cozy cabin, hunt for hidden treasure, or level up while doing absolutely nothing heroic for a minute.
Easy progress, low stress, steady rewards—that's what we call relaxed, efficient progression
[Auto-Battles Are Easy, But Never Boring]
Tired of idle games where heroes just stand still? Here, AI-driven characters adapt to the battlefield—repositioning, predicting enemies, chasing targets, and unleashing ultimate skills. Auto-battles aren’t boring—they’re tactical, flashy, and full of epic combos.
[Unique avatars, without looking the same]
Your avatar is yours, full stop. Go bold with wild hairstyles, unusual features, standout looks, or choices that are a little chaotic in the best way. Make something cool, weird, stylish, hilarious—or all four at once! No "same face, different outfit." Make it 100% original. Walk into town and stand out. In Kanstein, being unforgettable is part of the fun.

apps.title: Medal Hunter: Military Game
apps.summary:
Step into the battlefield in Medal Hunter, a fast-paced shooting game experience where precision, timing, and skill determine every victory. In this intense combat shooting world, you operate powerful military weapons positioned across dangerous warzones, tasked with intercepting enemy forces approaching from the air, sea, and land. Every encounter demands focus. Success belongs to players who can track targets, anticipate movement, and fire at exactly the right moment. The intensity of the front lines is brought to life through stylized, attractive visuals and cinematic audio effects that make every explosion and engine roar feel visceral.

Medal Hunter places you behind specialized war shooting weapons designed to stop incoming enemy units before they escape. Fighter planes streak across the sky, naval vessels cut through open water, and armored vehicles advance across the ground in the middle of large-scale battles. Your role is to stay calm under pressure, follow the movement of each target, and release a perfectly timed shot that turns the tide of battle.

For those seeking competition, Medal Hunter brings intense one-on-one PvP battles against players from around the world in competitive shooting encounters. Battles unfold in fast three-round matches where every decision counts. Victory doesn’t depend on luck or random mechanics — it comes down to skillful shooting accuracy, sharp reflexes, and tactical judgment. In these quick competitive duels, the player who tracks targets more precisely and demonstrates superior shooting skills claims the win.

As you progress, you’ll unlock a powerful arsenal of specialized war weapons built for different combat shooting scenarios. Explosive Flak Cannons tear through incoming aircraft with devastating blasts. Advanced naval cannons/guns are designed to intercept naval targets moving across open water. Precision Guns allow you to eliminate ground vehicles and armored units with deadly accuracy. Each weapon can be upgraded to increase its damage, bullet speed, rate of fire, and overall war shooting power. The more you develop your arsenal, the more dominant your battlefield performance becomes.

Your battles will take place across diverse war operations inspired by different theaters of conflict: Warsaw, Gibraltar, Pearl Harbor and more. Each location introduces new challenges and enemy types, from fast fighter jets and massive naval vessels to tanks and armored vehicles. Every battlefield demands a different tactical approach, forcing you to adapt your weapon choices and shooting tactics to survive the chaos of war.

Gain a tactical edge by equipping a Gunner—a consumable specialist that grants powerful, fixed passive stat boosts to your weapons for the duration of any battle.

Players can also join Clubs to fight alongside other sharpshooters and take part in cooperative war missions. Club members work together in special Club Boss battles, where the entire group attempts to defeat a powerful enemy target. Victory depends on the combined performance of the whole club — every accurate shooting strike brings the team closer to destroying the boss and claiming the reward.

Climb the competitive war leagues and prove yourself against players worldwide. With every victory you collect medals, advance through the ranks, and move closer to becoming a true master of precision combat. You can showcase your trophies in Soldier's Haven - your private Trophy Room. Only the most skilled war shooters will earn the title of Medal Hunter.

The journey to the top is paved with constant progression; as you play, you will unlock new exotic locations, earn exclusive rewards, and gather rare collectibles to complete the Haven. Every milestone allows you to get challenging achievements and level up your profile to show the world your veteran status.

Take your position.
Track the target.
Fire the perfect shot.

Download Medal Hunter and enter the ultimate shooting battlefield.

The last bastion of humanity has fallen. As the Commander of a final group of survivors, you face a grim new world in the aftermath of doomsday. You hid in an abandoned underground shelter. Build your underground stronghold, but remember: survival demands more than walls—it requires expansion, exploration, and relentless combat.​

Last Shelter: War Z offers a rich, strategic survival experience with a focus on exploration, combat, and cooperation. The apocalypse was the end of the world, but this is the start of yours. Will you lead humanity to rebirth? Download now and begin your underground odyssey!
